description: Scenario / conditions ONLY — the inputs that set up the power solution (companion to docs/requirements.md). Contains NO derived values: AC running power, duty cycle, daily energy, array/battery/inverter sizing, etc. are all computed per part combination by scripts/solve.py using data/metrics.json. Every field has value, unit, definition, and status (known | assumption | open). Edit here to retarget.

meta.use_case: Cool a shaded desert tent while sleeping during the day, off a DIY solar + LiFePO4 system.

location.definition: Install location; drives sun and cooling demand.

peak_sun_hours.definition: Equivalent full-sun hours; design around the worst usable value.

outside_temp_day.definition: Design daytime high (~38-43 degC); the temperature the AC works against.

outside_temp_night.definition: Typical overnight low (big desert diurnal swing).

relative_humidity.definition: Dry air — refrigerant AC dehumidifies; evaporative would add humidity.

dust_exposure.definition: Drives sealed enclosure + filter cleaning needs.

floor_area.definition: Tent footprint (~two queen mattresses, ~6 m2 / ~65 sqft).

shading.definition: Already out of direct sun — the single biggest load reducer.

added_insulation.definition: Reflective tarp/insulation are parked efficiency add-ons (docs/efficiency-backlog.md); not assumed here.

occupancy_count.definition: Number of occupants (each adds sensible+latent heat).

envelope_ua.definition: CONSERVATIVE (high) heat-transfer coefficient of the leaky shaded tent (conduction + infiltration). Deliberately over-estimates the load so the solution is over-sized; calibrate DOWN from a measured AC duty/power. Load = envelope_ua x (outside_temp_day - target_indoor_temp) + gains.

solar_gain.definition: Conservative residual solar heat gain through the shade.

occupancy_gain.definition: Conservative heat added per occupant x occupancy_count (sensible + latent).

cooling_hours.definition: Hours the AC runs per day.

overnight_cooling.definition: Desert nights are cool; no overnight cooling by design.

non_ac_loads.definition: Itemized non-AC loads; the daily total is derived (sum of watts x hours), not stored here.

cloudy_day_bridge.definition: Days of reduced-solar (overcast) operation the battery must carry beyond the daily buffer. 0 = daytime solar-direct only; raising this is the main lever that grows the battery.

battery_buffer_runtime.definition: AC-only runtime the buffer battery must cover (surge + passing clouds + shoulders of solar noon).

cloudy_derate.definition: Fraction of nameplate solar yield on a heavily overcast day (for bridge sizing).

usable_depth_of_discharge.definition: LiFePO4 daily DoD used to convert usable Wh to nominal battery kWh.

system_voltage.definition: Battery bus voltage — undecided globally (each config in configs.json targets a specific bus).

battery_chemistry.definition: LiFePO4 only (safety, cycle life, deep DoD).

cooling_required.definition: Active refrigerant AC is the required core; must hit comfort + low humidity on its own (decisions/0004).

portability.definition: Packs down, quick setup/teardown, wind- & dust-hardened.

budget_ceiling.definition: Total parts budget cap — set to constrain part choices.
